name: Arabinogalactan
description: Arabinogalactan (CAS 9036-66-2 ), also marketed under the trade name FiberAid and approved as E409 , is a naturally derived polysaccharide extracted primarily from larch wood. It functions as a dietary fiber source and prebiotic agent. This multifunctional texturizer is used across food, pharmaceutical, and personal care manufacturing. In food and beverage formulations, it acts as a low-viscosity bulking agent and fiber-enrichment ingredient for various products. It enables high inclusion rates without significantly altering product texture or mouthfeel. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as a tablet binder and excipient, and it is increasingly incorporated into immune-support dietary supplements. Due to its prebiotic classification, it is a popular choice for gut health formulations. In personal care, it improves skin feel and moisture retention in serums, creams, and leave-on treatments without adding heavy viscosity. Agricultural applications include its use as a carrier and dispersant in crop protection formulations. This improves the delivery of active ingredients while maintaining stability in diverse environmental conditions for industrial use. The product is supplied as a free-flowing white to off-white powder. It is available in food-grade and USP -compliant specifications, with FCC -grade material commonly sourced for dietary supplement and functional food applications. Bulk quantities are standard for industrial buyers requiring consistent supply chains.
